document.text: 离线转写工具由林悦负责测试，目前只是内部验证，公开发布尚未批准。要保存每一段原始录音，用户修改后的转写不能被自动结果覆盖。录音中暂停应该保留音频边界，继续录音之后的时间戳必须连续。噪声场景先测风扇和键盘声音，不要把安静时段编成文字。英文和中文都要测试，混合说话时保留英文产品名称的正确拼写。字幕界面需要明确展示原文和翻译，翻译使用本地模型。模型下载需要联网，录音和纪要处理完全离线，不共享会议内容。测试报告要包括字错率、词错率和转写延迟，不能只写处理成功。今天只讨论这些验收要求，没有完成系统音频采集，也没有确定新版本发布日期。最后确认，公开发布仍然没有批准，林悦先在周四提交测试报告。

captions.source: 离线转写工具由林悦负责测试，目前只是内部验证，公开发布尚未批准。

captions.source: 要保存每一段原始录音，用户修改后的转写不能被自动结果覆盖。

translation.text: To save each segment of the original recording, the modified transcription cannot be automatically overwritten by the output result.

captions.source: 录音中暂停应该保留音频边界，继续录音之后的时间戳必须连续。

translation.text: The audio boundaries should be preserved when the recording is paused, and the timestamp after resuming the recording must be continuous.

captions.source: 噪声场景先测风扇和键盘声音，不要把安静时段编成文字。

translation.text: Noise scenario: first measure fan and keyboard sounds, do not convert quiet periods into text.

captions.source: 英文和中文都要测试，混合说话时保留英文产品名称的正确拼写。

translation.text: English and Chinese should both be tested, and English product names should be spelled correctly when mixed speech occurs.

captions.source: 字幕界面需要明确展示原文和翻译，翻译使用本地模型。

translation.text: The subtitle interface should clearly display the original text and translation, using a local model for the translation.

captions.source: 模型下载需要联网，录音和纪要处理完全离线，不共享会议内容。

translation.text: Model download requires internet, recording and note processing are completely offline, and no sharing of meeting content is allowed.

captions.source: 测试报告要包括字错率、词错率和转写延迟，不能只写处理成功。

translation.text: The test report should include word error rate, sentence error rate, and transcription delay, and should not only mention successful processing.

production_changes: JSON-safe name-reference grammar retains valid escaped prose and literal source names; a single leading subject is anchored at the start.
Output-token exhaustion is typed as uncommitted content failure, not a failed GPU transport; caption batches yield rather than replaying the entire batch on CPU.
Whole isolated conjunctions and neutral hesitation sounds use bounded literal translations, with ordinary fact/name/revision/cache checks and explicit glossary precedence.
Literal digit-by-digit readings preserve exact numeric sequence; new numbers, amounts and currencies remain rejected.
Explicit retained task deadlines preserve the named source subject. Subjectless budget-approval continuations stay pending without borrowing a different failed test.
Translation environment v11 and automatic-document v11 invalidate old derived results; source and human paragraphs stay protected.

manual_review.scope: All 32 final minutes checked against their original fixture inputs; focused caption checks separately assert names/language/numbers. This is not natural ASR accuracy acceptance.
checks: Latest corrected English budget is 5000, independent invoice remains 3000, pending approval preserved.
Completed upload replaces only upload pending state; independent invoice/accessibility work remains unfinished.
Unspoken note names remain absent; actual source names, current revision citations and protected human paragraphs retained.
Chinese internal/public release distinction and offline/system-audio qualifiers retained.
Literal raw all-caps and mixed source identities retained without inferring different institutions, people or hardware.
limits: Noisy/repeated readings remain repetitive and less polished than clean speech.
Some translations remain awkward: owns a report becomes 拥有报告; one noisy festival line uses 夜幕降临 and another retains festival. No claim of general translation accuracy or full editorial quality.
Standalone fragments deliberately stay fragments; literal source spellings do not repair natural ASR recognition.

pending: Windows same-candidate CUDA corpus/original92s and native/cold-start recheck; Realtek ASR-name work stays separate.
Mac same-candidate integrated ASR/Metal recording and native lifecycle recheck.
Linux/Omarchy platform checks at the same candidate; missing physical GPU devices remain explicitly untested.
Unified candidate installation/upgrade/model retention and signed optional-component/CPU fallback checks before release.
Broader performance, bounded diarization, optional-backend research and delta updating continue independently.
